strategy_roster.name: MA CrossOver
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(100) above EMA(400) indicates long-term trend. Corpus uses cross (1min), approximated by sustained state for daily+. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Keltner Channel Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Keltner Channel: EMA(20) center + 2*ATR(14) bands. Long breakout above upper band, exit when price drops below lower band or stop-loss. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Surge
strategy_roster.notes: Volume ratio above 2x with price above MA(20) confirms participation in uptrend. Exit when volume normalizes or price drops below MA. VolumeSurgeMultiplier=2.0 documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Band Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: Close above upper Bollinger band with a bearish candle (close<open) signals fade. Exit when price returns to middle band. ATR-based stop approximated as percent. BollingerPeriod=20, Deviation=2.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Histogram Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: MACD line above signal line (histogram positive) signals bullish momentum. Exit on reverse cross. Standard 12/26/9 parameters. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Climax Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: Volume climax with bearish candle signals exhaustion. Enter long anticipating reversal when volume normalizes. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Triple MA
strategy_roster.notes: Triple EMA stack (5/20/50) for strong trend confirmation. Long when fast > medium > slow. Exit when fast crosses below medium. ShortMa=5, MiddleMa=20, LongMa=50 documented.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Overbought Oversold
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) below 30 (oversold) enters long, exits when RSI returns to neutral (50). NeutralLevel=50 documented. StopLoss=2%.

strategy_roster.name: Bar Range
strategy_roster.notes: Large bearish bar (range > 2*ATR) signals selling climax. Enter long on reversal candle (close>open). LookbackPeriod=50/PercentRankThreshold=95 approximated as 2*ATR comparison. ExitBars=1.

strategy_roster.name: BB Width Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2) > 2 * atr(high,low,close,14) and close > bb_mid(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger Band width (upper-lower) exceeds 2*ATR while price above middle band indicates volatility expansion breakout. Exit when price returns to mid. BollingerPeriod=20, Deviation=2.
